title: Mail
subtitle: Inboxes for you, your team and your agents.
disabled: Mail is not enabled on this installation yet.
emptyBody: Prepare personal and agent mailboxes on your organization's domains. Each mailbox has its own responsible person and access.
emptyFolderBody: Receiving and sending will be enabled after the email service is configured.
choose: Choose a mailbox to view its preparation
privateBody: Managing the registry does not automatically grant access to personal mailbox content. Only the responsible person and authorized people gain access.
preparingBody: The address is reserved. Receiving, sending and email clients still await activation.
name: Mailbox name
createHint: Registration reserves the address; it does not change DNS or enable receiving.
noDomains: Add a domain to the organization to prepare your first mailbox.
domainNote: Domain sending verification is separate from receiving configuration.
error: Could not save. Check the details and try again.
conflict: This address is already reserved. Choose a different address.
accessHint: Permissions apply to this mailbox only and cease when a person leaves the organization. They do not enable sending.
ownerMissing: A responsible person needs to be assigned
registeredBody: Responsible person, domain and permissions defined.
transportBody: Next: email service and private messages.
clientsBody: IMAP/JMAP and API/MCP will be connected after mailbox qualification.
managementOnly: You manage the registry; reading requires mailbox authorization.
pausedBody: Access to this mailbox is suspended. An administrator can review the registry.

sendAccepted: Message accepted by the sending service. Follow its status in Sent.

sentReplyPending: The final identifier for this sent message has not been confirmed yet. Reply is unavailable until it is confirmed so the conversation can stay connected.
subject: Subject
attachmentLimit: Up to 10 attachments of 256 KB each; complete message up to 1 MB.
attachmentError: The file could not be read. Try again.
draftConflict: This draft changed in another session. Your text stays here; copy it and reopen the current version before saving.

draftError: The draft could not be saved. Check recipients and attachment sizes. Your text stays here.
draftOnly: Save and prepare your reply. Sending will be enabled after the email service is configured.
contentError: Messages could not be loaded. Check your access and try again.
sendingInactive: Sending is awaiting activation. Your drafts are in the Drafts folder.
listLimit: This view shows up to 50 recent messages across 20 mailboxes. Pagination will be expanded in the next step.
noText: This message has no text version. You can download its attachments.
selectMessageBody: Select a message to read and prepare your reply.
contentPrivate: Private messages and attachments. Every request rechecks mailbox access.
previewBody: Prepare your inboxes and drafts. Receiving and sending are not active yet.
inboxEmptyBody: Incoming email will appear here when receiving is active.
draftsEmptyBody: Prepare a message and continue whenever you like.
sentEmptyBody: Your sent messages will appear here when sending is active.
